absentByDesign: no multi-parent merge; the base is a single known ancestor and an unknown one is diagnosed
no automatic re-grounding; a moved target yields a stale proposal
no automatic merge of any kind
no safe_to_merge boolean, because structure, constraints, assurance, authority and currency are five questions
no second impact engine; the constraint check reuses what already exists

designConsequence: Alpha and Beta change different fields, so there is no value conflict to detect. A system that only compared values would merge them cleanly and produce a target that breaks its own rule. The gate is therefore a constraint check on the reconstructed candidate.

fixture.base: capacity 100, load_a 40, load_b 40, rule load_a + load_b <= capacity
fixture.nature: invented arithmetic for tests; not Sarah, not IntentLane, not a real budget
fixture.oracle: a separate program over plain integers that calls nothing in world_kernel::branch and reads no expected value

mutations.mutation: drop the constraint check on the composed candidate
treat a partial selection as a full merge
accept a proposal whose target revision moved
guess an unknown base instead of refusing

notAuthorised: the other 26 stories of the 32-story matrix, which ADR-004 does not authorise
portable export and import of branch history, conditioned on M2 and not attempted
human utility, which needs a person and cannot be measured by a test count
bounded generative trees, which arrive with the runner in a later tranche
that a branch isolation test proves network or plugin isolation; it does not
notMeasured: no cost per evaluation, so no claim in euros, tokens or human time
no replanning cost from the conservative compare-and-swap, which is retained deliberately
no equal-information comparison against a competent branching application, which the M1 and M3 protocol would both require before any claim of superiority
no real consumer: the fixture is invented arithmetic

primaryTest.claim: Alpha and Beta are each sound at 95. Their composition is 110 against a capacity of 100. The candidate is built, the rule is checked on it, the target does not move, and the refusal names the rule and the versions examined.
primaryTest.counterweight: a_revised_branch_composing_exactly_to_the_limit_is_admissible, because a test that blocks every adoption is not a test
primaryTest.name: a_combination_of_two_valid_branches_is_blocked_and_the_target_does_not_move
